title: Introduce hierarchical splay sampling and tilt-aware alert curves for invocation telemetry
author: Maya R. Chen
description:
Motivation: Noise and synchronized sampling in invocation telemetry have been leading to brittle alerting during bursty workloads and rollout windows. This PR introduces a hierarchical splay sampling algorithm plus an associated tilt-aware alert curve generator that reduces correlated sampling artifacts and gives on-call friendly alerts for short-term bursts.

What this implements: hierarchical splay sampler (apps/observability) that staggers sampling across invocation cohorts, a small telemetry header injected into spans (sample_phase + splay_id) for downstream correlation, a tilt-aware alert curve generator that adapts hysteresis and quiet windows based on observed burst 'tilt' metrics, and a dashboard + runbook with example tuning knobs. The description below contains the full proposal, commits, changed areas, review convo summary, and rollout plan.

Design summary: The splay sampler assigns each invocation to a cohort based on hashed customer+route and then assigns a time-splayed window within a configurable epoch. Two levels: cohort-level splay to avoid per-tenant alignment and epoch-level jitter to avoid system-wide synchronization. The sampler emits lightweight tags: sample_phase (0..N-1), splay_cohort, and splay_epoch. Tilt metric is computed from a short rolling histogram of arrival inter-arrival variance and token-rate slope; the alert curve generator uses tilt to widen alerts during high-burst windows and tighten during steady-state.

Files and surface changes (high level): services/observability/src/sampling/splay_sampler.rs - new sampler and CLI flags; services/observability/src/telemetry/span_tags.rs - added sample_phase and splay_cohort injection; infra/alerting/splay_rules.yaml - new Prometheus/SLO rules with tilt-aware dampening; dashboards/observability/splay-tilt-dashboard.json - Grafana dashboard showing splay cohort heatmap, tilt score, and adaptive alert bands; docs/observability/splay.md - design doc and tuning runbook; tests/splay_sim_integration.py - simulation-driven unit/integration tests; SDK/py telemetry helper minor patch to decode splay tags.

Commits summary: 1) Add core hierarchical splay sampler and unit tests (author: Maya) 2) Add tilt scorer and adaptive alert DSL + dashboard (author: Maya) 3) Add simulation harness and integration tests, docs and runbook (author: Maya) 4) Address review feedback: edge-case guard for short-lived invocations and fallback to uniform sampling (author: Maya).

Review conversation (condensed): Diego: "Nice. two quick asks: add an end-to-end integration test that verifies per-cohort coverage during a burst, and make the splay epoch configurable via env var for private installs." Maya: "Added splay_sim and exposed SPLASH_EPOCH env var; updated docs with private-deploy note." Priya: "Can tilt use an existing latency-metric instead of bespoke histogram?" Maya: "Tilt uses short-term inter-arrival variance; added mapping table in docs to correlate to latency delta if teams prefer that toggle." Lars: "Please ensure this doesn't regress sampling cardinality in high-tenant counts." Maya: "Added bounded cohort allocation with deterministic fallback; included unit tests covering 1k tenants."

CI and tests: Initial CI run failed linting on telemetry header naming; fixed to use _kebab-case_ and re-ran. Integration simulation caught a pathological case when epoch << average burst length; added epoch min guard and updated tests. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, linters, dashboard validation).

Migration and rollout: Feature gated behind OBS_SPLAY_ENABLED (off by default). Plan: Canary on perf-canary cluster for 48h with both sampling modes active, compare alert noise delta and cost delta (we expect <1% token-cost increase, ~35% reduction in correlated alert triggers in synthetic bust tests). After negative results threshold check, flip to gradual rollout for hosted (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with canary metrics. For Private installs add config guide in docs.

Operational notes: Exposed metrics: observability.splay.sampled_invocations_total{cohort,phase}, observability.splay.tilt_score{route,tenant}, observability.splay.coverage_ratio{tenant}. Added dashboard panels: cohort heatmap, tilt trend, coverage per-tenant, and adaptive alert band overlay. Runbook includes steps to temporarily disable splay sampler and revert to uniform sampling by toggling OBS_SPLAY_ENABLED and restarting the observability service.

Security and privacy: splay cohorts are derived from a one-way hash of tenant_id+route; no raw tenant identifiers are emitted. Tags are intentionally low-cardinality (cohort id not raw tenant id).

Release notes: Adds a hierarchical splay sampling algorithm and tilt-aware alert curves to reduce correlated alert noise during bursts. Feature gated and off by default; see docs/observability/splay.md for configuration and runbook.
